body.intro: Discussing pay has always been awkward, especially when you step into a conversation without knowing where you actually stand. Most people are forced to rely on uncomfortable whispers with colleagues or outdated annual reports to guess their true market value.
body.outro: Our mission is simple: to give every employee the data they need to negotiate with confidence. We believe that when salary data is open and accessible, the pay gap closes and everyone wins.

1.title: Real-Time Data
1.body: Every score blends live Adzuna vacancies with official ONS benchmarks, refreshed continuously.

2.title: No Guesswork
2.body: Get a definitive MCA Score from 1-99 instead of a vague 'ballpark' salary range.

3.title: Built For Negotiation
3.body: Walk into your next review with evidence, not just instinct.

body.bold: Data-driven alignment is the key to a fair and efficient job market.
body.intro: For too long, the true value of a role has been a moving target, obscured by outdated data and inconsistent reporting. This imbalance makes it difficult for employers to stay competitive and for candidates to know their worth.
body.middle: {app-name} was developed to bridge this informational gap through real-time data integration.
body.outro: The platform's mission is to provide an objective, data-backed standard for salary transparency. By cross-referencing 700,000+ active vacancies with official benchmarks, we ensure that every hiring decision and career move is rooted in current market reality, fostering a more equitable landscape for everyone

1.title: Live Market Signal
1.body: Every benchmark blends 700,000+ active vacancies with official ONS data, refreshed continuously.

2.title: Objective Scoring
2.body: Replace 'gut feel' salary bands with a definitive MCA Score employers and candidates both trust.

3.title: Built For Hiring Decisions
3.body: Validate an offer before you post it, and defend it with confidence when you extend it.
